summary: Randolph County, WV tower site (US 1689, registered 2017) with no build or removal date. The association marks it gone and lists a standing tower at Godwin, marked private.

facts.status_note: The association marks the Parting Springs site as gone; it lists a standing tower at Godwin (Randolph County) as relocated from here.

access.note: The association list marks the Godwin location as private.

events.note: Registered January 26, 2017; nominated by Brian M. Powell
Association list places a standing tower at Godwin, Randolph County, as relocated from Parting Springs; no date or mover given

notes_for_editor: Only two sources were read: the FFLOS register page (fact-check 2026-10-09: only registry, date, nominator, location, coordinates, elevation and administrator fields; no build, removal or description text) and the FFA WV list. The WV Encyclopedia entry (wvencyclopedia.org/entries/2115) was checked with a grep for Parting, Godwin, Rich Mountain and Snowshoe and had no matching lines. The Godwin tower rests on a single list entry marked Private; no owner, build date, height, or move date was found. What, if anything, remains at the Parting Springs site is unknown. The WebSearch call for this tower was refused because the shared WebSearch budget for the run was already used up; websearch.py was not used to get around the limit. Re-search for the Parting Springs tower history and the Godwin tower before publishing.
